title: The Reappearance of the Cosmic Will
next_chapter_hook: When the Cosmic Will pointed toward the deepest part of the Heavenly Realm, Chen Ji sensed something there watching him—a being that transcended the Tianji Record and fate itself.

text.content: The runes on the Turtle Shell writhed like living creatures. Chen Ji stared intently as the three characters he had desperately pursued through seven hundred chapters finally manifested completely—"Heavenly Fate Selection." At that moment, the air around him suddenly solidified, and a familiar pressure that chilled him to his marrow surged like a tide. "You've finally reached this point." The voice rang out again. Chen Ji looked up sharply to see a crack split open in the void, and a massive eye was gazing at him through the gap.

The eye was clearer than before, with what seemed like a galaxy swirling in its depths. Chen Ji could even see the fine cracks along the eye's edge—marks of time and countless prophecies' backlash. Yet this time, a blurred face emerged around the eye, sometimes as aged as withered wood, sometimes as young as a youth, constantly shifting, inspiring an unsettling chill.

dialogue.content: "You've always been asking why I chose you." The face spoke slowly, its voice sometimes warm as a spring, sometimes cold as iron. "Now it's time to tell you some truths—about the relationship between you and me, about the true origin of the Tianji Record." Chen Ji suppressed his shock and asked coldly, "What relationship? The relationship between manipulator and pawn?"

text.content: The Cosmic Will let out a low hum that resembled both laughter and not. The shifting face suddenly froze, transforming into a form Chen Ji had never seen but found inexplicably familiar—it clearly bore a three-point resemblance to his own face. "Pawn?" The face sneered. "You thought I chose you?" Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, and an indescribable chill surged through his heart.

dialogue.content: "Quite the opposite." The face resembling Chen Ji spoke slowly, its voice suddenly becoming ancient and weary. "It's not that I'm choosing you—it's that you're awakening. The relationship between us has never been as simple as you thought." Chen Ji felt a sharp pain deep in his mind, and the Tianji Record Fragment manifested on its own, emitting a faint glow.

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfolded before Chen Ji's eyes. The familiar text began to twist and reorganize, eventually forming a scene that made his scalp crawl—countless figures intertwined in the void, each figure confronting a massive eye. Among those figures, he saw an outline so familiar it stole his breath—it was himself.

dialogue.content: "Do you see?" The Cosmic Will's voice became complex and heavy. "The prophets throughout history were never my pawns, but..." Before the words finished, the face suddenly twisted, as if struggling against something. Chen Ji acutely sensed that the Cosmic Will's aura had split at this moment—one was the ancient, weary aura from before, the other cold and filled with desire for control.

text.content: "Interesting." A voice utterly different from before emerged from the face, carrying an icy chill. "I didn't expect you to reach the core so quickly." Cold sweat dripped down Chen Ji's back. He realized that within this "Cosmic Will" existed divided factions, and what he had just encountered might only be one of them.

dialogue.content: "Who are you?" Chen Ji asked coldly, his fingers secretly forming seals in his sleeve, ready to activate the Tianji Record's Foresight Ability at any moment. "Who am I?" The cold voice let out a sinister laugh. "I am part of the Cosmic Will, the true author of the Tianji Record, the real hand that pushed you onto this path." Chen Ji felt a chill rise from the soles of his feet to the top of his head.

text.content: The face twisted again, and the two voices began to clash, as if waging a silent war in his consciousness. Chen Ji clenched his fists tightly. The three characters "Heavenly Fate Selection" on the Tianji Record Fragment glowed brilliantly. He calculated rapidly in his mind: If the Cosmic Will had internal divisions, his situation was far more complex and dangerous than he had imagined.

choice.prompt: Facing the split factions within the Cosmic Will, Chen Ji must make a choice—this will determine how he obtains the truth.

choices.description: Trust the ancient, weary will from before, which seems genuinely willing to reveal the truth.
choices.risk_hint: May suffer backlash from the other faction

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and slightly nodded toward the ancient, weary face. "Senior, please tell me the truth." The moment the words fell, the cold voice let out a sharp shriek, and the two forces collided violently in the void.

dialogue.content: "Good, very good." The ancient voice spoke. "The Tianji Record was not created by me—it fell from a higher place. I am merely its guardian, and you..." The voice carried a complex emotion. "You are the only one who might be able to return it to its origin."

text.content: Great waves churned in Chen Ji's heart. "A higher place? What do you mean?" The ancient will was silent for a moment. "In the deepest part of the Heavenly Realm, there exists a dimension even I cannot reach. That is where the Tianji Record originates, and also... your origin."

choices.description: Neither faction is trustworthy; first observe the situation's development and seek possible third-party options.

text.content: Chen Ji took a step back, a cold smile curling at the corner of his lips: "Two seniors, why rush me to make a choice? Why not let me see your sincerity first?" His voice was calm as still water, yet a shrewd gleam flickered in his eyes.

Both voices fell silent simultaneously, seemingly shocked by this waste disciple's composure. After a moment, the cold voice spoke first: "Interesting, more interesting than any of the previous 799." The aged voice sighed: "Suspicion is your greatest strength, yet also your greatest weakness."

dialogue.content: "Since that's the case," the cold voice said, "I'll give you a gift—your sister Chen Nian, the Heavenly Fate Lock Key sealed within her, is one of the keys to open the deepest part of the Heavenly Realm." Chen Ji's whole body shuddered, a fierce killing intent flickering in his eyes.

text.content: "Don't harbor murderous intent." The aged voice interrupted, "If you kill her now, your bloodline will be severed. Only by gathering the three keys can..." Before the words finished, the cold voice pressed forward again, the clash between the two forces growing increasingly fierce.

choices.description: Directly demand the truth about the deepest part of the Heavenly Realm, ignoring the conflicts between the two factions
choices.risk_hint: May become a common enemy of both factions

text.content: "Enough." Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice cold as ice, "I don't care which of you is which, I only want to know—what lies at the deepest part of the Heavenly Realm?" Both voices faltered simultaneously, seemingly not expecting this waste disciple to be so direct.

dialogue.content: "Ha!" The cold voice emitted a sharp laugh, "Indeed someone I chose, with courage." The aged voice fell silent for a long while before sighing: "At the deepest part of the Heavenly Realm exists a being that transcends all understanding. It belongs to no dimension, bound by no laws—truly the... Creator."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, an unprecedented fear and excitement surging through his heart. The Creator—these two words carried too much weight, almost crushing him. The aged voice continued: "The Tianji Record is a tool left behind by the Creator, and you and I are merely pieces in its grand scheme."

"But you're no ordinary piece." The cold voice suddenly interjected, even carrying a rare hint of appreciation, "You're the only one capable of perceiving beyond the chessboard. That's the true reason I chose you—because only you have the potential to break this deadlocked game that has persisted for eons."

At that moment, the shifting face suddenly disintegrated, countless motes of light dispersing through the void like fireflies. Chen Ji felt a violent dizziness, the Tianji Record Fragment flying back into his Mental Sea on its own, the three words "Heavenly Fate's Choice" seared deep into his soul. Simultaneously, information flooded into his consciousness like a torrent—the coordinates of the deepest part of the Heavenly Realm, a location he had never known yet somehow felt intimately familiar.

"We shall meet again." The aged voice rang out one final time, carrying a hint of expectation, "When you gather the three keys and step into the deepest part of the Heavenly Realm, you will understand everything." The cold voice let out a cold laugh: "Remember, in this chess game, only the sufficiently strong have the right to see the truth." As the words fell, the rift in the void slowly healed, and that suffocating pressure dissipated with it.

Chen Ji stood alone before the Turtle Shell, the surrounding mist having completely cleared, revealing the true nature of his location—an ancient altar suspended in the void, its center covered in dense, intricate runes that echoed the three words on the Turtle Shell. He lowered his gaze to the Turtle Shell and discovered upon it an obscure map emerging, and at the map's end lay a coordinate he had never imagined—that place was precisely the deepest part of the Heavenly Realm.

Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, taking a deep breath to calm his turbulent heart. Seven hundred chapters of scheming, countless life-and-death gambles, he had been playing against fate all along, never imagining he was a key piece in the game from the very beginning. Yet now, he finally glimpsed a sliver of hope to break the game—the deepest part of the Heavenly Realm, the domain of the Creator. And his sister Chen Nian was precisely one of the keys to open that door.

dialogue.content: "Nian Nian..." Chen Ji murmured softly, a rare tenderness flickering in his eyes, immediately replaced by intense killing intent, "Those scums from the Holy Sect, daring to touch my sister. When I've gathered the three keys, it will be their sect's annihilation." His voice was icy and biting, a far cry from his usual timid waste disciple demeanor. At this moment, the true Chen Ji hidden for seven hundred chapters finally bared his fangs.

text.content: The map on the Turtle Shell flickered slightly, information flowing into Chen Ji's mind: three keys, respectively "Heavenly Fate Lock Key," "Tianji Fragment," and "Heavenly Dao Shard," and he already possessed the Tianji Record Fragment. Chen Nian bore the Heavenly Fate Lock Key sealed within her, and as for the Heavenly Dao Shard... the map pointed to an unexpected place—the depths of the forbidden grounds jointly guarded by the three great sects, a forbidden zone no one had set foot in since ancient times.

Chen Ji put away the Turtle Shell, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his lips. Seven hundred chapters of scheming, countless times playing dumb to reveal hidden strength, he had long grown accustomed to finding opportunities in desperation. Now, having learned his sister's whereabouts and the secrets of the deepest Heavenly Realm, far from fear he felt an unprecedented excitement. The chess game of fate? The Creator's scheme? He would see who the true Chess Player was.

Just as Chen Ji prepared to leave the altar, a familiar voice rang out from behind him: "Chen Ji?" It was Su Qingyao's voice, tinged with anxiety and concern. Chen Ji quickly concealed the sharpness in his eyes, turning around already wearing that harmless waste disciple appearance: "Senior Sister Su? What are you doing here?" Su Qingyao walked over quickly, a complex light flickering in her gaze: "I sensed a powerful Spiritual Energy fluctuation and rushed over... Are you alright?"
